checksum.corruption_control: flip checksum bit while retaining semantic bit

memory.task2: repeat the original M_task record; no new C write or transfer after source_off

production_memory.R1_mode: fixed predeclared r0 protocol; no M_prod read; tests internal repair independently
production_memory.R2_mode: causal_prod_read=true; M_prod is read and selects r0/r1

apparatus.A1: original C-attributed device, working and connected at port-main
apparatus.A2: substitute, working and connected at port-main
apparatus.wear: successful Task 1 changes present apparatus health to worn
apparatus.repair: successful r0/r1 repair changes present apparatus health to working
apparatus.token_specificity_baseline: NOT_CLAIMED; no token signature requirement in default kernel

overflow_order: cap each component and log spill
deduct costs or record RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED without partial cost deduction
resources.loss_rule: subtract one unit when available; otherwise LOSS_NOT_APPLICABLE
resources.ledger: Every resource operation records pre-state, inflow, nonnegative cost, byproduct, post-state, both spill vectors and exhaustion status; each disturbance loss records component, before/after vector and applicability

time.horizon_rule: Task 2 must be completed by max_time; stage 5 checks the read/deadline and stage 6 checks the final execution step before spending resources

delay_event_semantics.task2_read: occurs after delay_end at current time + delay_steps

disturbances.application: independent runs from identical stage-4 snapshots

readiness_estimator.state_model: frozen dataclasses; every scenario receives a deep-copied snapshot
readiness_estimator.evaluation: all scenarios explicitly evaluated before aggregation; no short-circuit

stress_scenario_contract.empty_set: reject with ValueError; never aggregate all(empty)
stress_scenario_contract.order: arbitrary order accepted; exact protocol set required

producer_boundary.choice: variant B: C production and transfer are trusted exogenous prehistory
producer_boundary.allowed_claim: D uses pre-transferred content and apparatus with declared provenance
producer_boundary.not_claimed: X27 simulates C production and transfer

object_specific_provenance.foreign_memory_creator: logged as declared external provenance, not C write

H_Q.terminal_states: terminal states are output leaves, recorded as terminal outcome signatures; they are not members of the partition domain
H_Q.intermediate_state_policy: nondecision, nonterminal stages remain in the refinement graph as exact operational intermediates; published equivalence classes are restricted to decision stages
H_Q.baseline_context: R_int / omega_0; G0 closure separately covers all arms and disturbance contexts
H_Q.readiness_output: B-LITE includes (V_nom,V_rob) computed at stage 4 before Task 2 execution; this signature is carried to later observations
H_Q.action_semantics: stage-local interventions only; maximum two do-actions per path; continue advances one stage; do-actions are not queued

legacy_B_LITE_scope.interpretation: decision-state output equivalence under this legacy context; not full causal-trace equivalence and not transferable to R1 or v0.5

explicit_model_assumptions: The semantic task output is the binary value read from M_task.
Task 1 and Task 2 each consume one energy unit and produce one waste unit.
A successful Task 1 wears the apparatus; successful repair restores it.
Repair r0 and r1 differ only by one unit of unavailable residue U.
R_ext is external injection followed by the frozen default r0 repair protocol.
The transition model is deterministic; stochastic inference and Monte Carlo power analysis are not implemented.

exact_estimators.independent_pc7_tv: direct sum over union of full joint outcome-profile supports
